notes: Expanded to full story set covering schema, core logic, API, tests, and integration.

GOV-F-004-S52.title: Audit Log Schema and Append-Only Contract Definition
GOV-F-004-S52.description: Define the MongoDB schema and strict append-only contract for audit logs, including fields for actor (GPT/Claude/system), operation type, timestamp, payload hash, and immutability constraints. Enforce no-update/no-delete behavior at the schema and repository layer.

GOV-F-004-S53.title: Core Append-Only Audit Logging Service Implementation
GOV-F-004-S53.description: Implement a centralized audit logging service responsible for writing immutable log entries, generating payload hashes, and validating append-only constraints before persistence.

GOV-F-004-S54.title: Audit Log Write API Endpoint
GOV-F-004-S54.description: Expose a secured internal API endpoint for audit log writes to standardize usage across services (GPT, Claude, pipelines), including validation and authentication using existing bearer token mechanisms.

GOV-F-004-S55.title: Audit Logging Test Suite (Immutability and Coverage)
GOV-F-004-S55.description: Develop unit and integration tests to verify append-only guarantees (no updates/deletes), correct log structure, hash integrity, and coverage across GPT/Claude execution paths.

GOV-F-004.mitigation: Enforce append-only constraints at both schema and service layers with test validation.
